rejected_candidate.description: delete the native molt_main idempotent molt_runtime_init call while retaining WASM and molt_host_init initialization

blocking_evidence: native release hello already clears the CPython process bar by 14.0x on the same machine
runtime initialization is about 1.024 ms, below the roughly 11-12 ms process floor
the only exposed duplicate init fast path produced no A12 net improvement and was removed
tools/startup_bench.py couples native and WASM builds, so a WASM link failure currently refuses the whole attestation even after native succeeds

unblock_condition.measurement: a target-specific phase or pre-main component with at least 0.5 ms median cost and a predicted >=2% end-to-end win
unblock_condition.samples: at least 7 serial alternating release samples per side plus cold-start treatment
unblock_condition.acceptance: tools/powerplay_acceptance.py strict Variant-II acceptance, held stdout/exit bench, and memory ceiling
unblock_condition.harness: native evidence must survive an independent WASM build failure
